title: Sey on annda ɗu’um dow NGILŊGU KORONA malla KOVID-
text:
Ngilŋgu Korona

Ngilŋgu Korona ewneteeŋgu boo Kovid-19, ɗum ngilŋgu kesu. Ɗum aarti waŋgugo haa lesdi Sin bee nyalaade 31 lewru Desember 2019. Ngu ɗon waŋga bee alaamaaji nannduɗi ɗi   ndammba, ɗum mbaran to ɗum tulliti. Ɗum ɗon tawe nder lesɗe ɗuuɗɗe  haa duniyaaru fuu. Iwde nyawu ngu’u anndaaka tawon.
Goɗɗo marɗo duuɓi ɗuuɗɗiGoɗɗo marɗo nyawu ɓernde malla maatanɗo nyawu ngoɗŋguYimɓe ɓe nyawu ngu’u naŋngata bee koyɗum

Ngilŋgu ngu’u foti nasta haa yimɓe marɓe duuɗi koo ɗiye fuu. Ngu naŋngan bee koyɗum e ngu torran marɓe duuɓi ɗuuɗɗi e marɓe nyawuuji  masin (bana cukku, nyawu sukar, nyawuuji ɓernde, tansiyon).
-Yontere
-Comri-Ndammba caatuka
-Naawral haa jokkeAlaamaaji nyawu ngu’u

Alaamaaji nyawu ngilŋgu korona nanndi bee ɗi marɗo ndammba: yontere, ndammba caatuka, naawral haa jokke, comri. Nyawuɓe woɗɓe boo ɗon maata naawral, kine cukkan, kine ilan, daande naawan malla caarol. Yimɓe woɗɓe ɓe nyawu ngu’u naŋngi mbaŋgintaa koo alaama ngoota, ɓe ɗon maata ɓe yamɓe. Ɓurna yimɓe ɗon nyawndo kurgun kastaaɗum.
Goɗɗo mo ɗon sonndaBana noy yimɓe ndaaɓirta nyawu ngilŋgu Korona?

Marɓe ngilŋgu KOVID-19 raaɓan woɗɓe. To nyawuɗo sonndi malla ɗisli, kuukon ɗon ngurto  gal kine malla gal hunnduko muuɗum. To goɗɗo foofi, kuukon kon nastan haa maako, nden foti nyaw man raaɓa mo. To goɗɗo meemi huunde nde kuukon kon ɗon dow maajum e to o meemi gite malla kine malla huunduko maako, foti nyaw man raaɓa mo.
Bana noy faddaago?1. Taa meeme gite, kine malla huunduko mon.2.  Loote juuɗe bee ndiyam laaɓɗam e bee saabulu. Nden ngooste juuɗe mon bee sarvet laaɗɓum.3. Connde malla ɗisle nder newre soɓɓundu mon.4. Taa nyaame kusel keccel, ta meeme boo dabbaaji geeti.
5. Ndaayotire baakin meetir gootel bee coondanɗo malla ɗislanɗo fuu.
6. Ndaaye hoofnindirgo juŋngo bee juŋngo.
7. Ndaaye mooɓorɗe mawɗe.8. Uste gaance mon.9. Tefe habaruuji dow ko ɗon saalo e linye iwde habaruuji ɗi’i.

title: Lazy Junior Brother
text:
To weeti fajiri, sey mi umma, mi soppita leɗɗe.
Mi huɓɓa yiite.
Mi dolla ndiyam.
Mi laanya faannde.
Mi layɓa taasaaje.
Mi wuuwa suudu.
Mi dilla huuwugo haa ngesa.
Jemma boo mi jannga.
Ko waɗi mi huuwata bana
                    nii ...

title: Préparer avec Maman
text:
Mi yiɗi defugo takay bee Inna.
Aran nii, Inna sa’i kusel haa faannde.
Sey mi setti dankaliije.
Mi ta’iti baafe kaabej.
Mi woggi karas.
Mi looti nyebbe.
Mi he’i haakooji.
Inna boo he’i tingeere.
Tingeere waati yam bojji!
Min waati pat nder faannde mawnde bee kusel man.
Min ɓili faannde man dow yiite.
Lartu ko a faami!

                    1. Ɗume ɓinngel yiɗi defugo bee Inna maako?

                    2. Ɗume bee ɗume on ɓinngel man hawti nder takay?

title: La Manie des Mangues
text:
Wakkati feere woodi no ɓinngel, innde maagel Bello.

                    Nyannde feere nde Bello ɗonno nyaama bee saarooji maako sey o sinki reedu maako ɗon naawa.
Sey daada maako ƴami mo, “Ɗume a nyaami hannde, Bello?”
                                    
                                        Bello wi’i, “Hannde mi nyaami mongorooje sappo. Jonta reedu am ɗon naawa.”
Daada maako wi’i, “Mongorooje sappo! Ko waɗi a nyaami mongorooje sappo?”
                            
                                                Sey Bello wi’i, “Nde mi metti arandeere, hakkee nde dakmi, sey mi yiɗi beddugo.
                                            
                                        “Nden nde mi metti ɗiɗaɓre, sey kayre fuu nde weli haa ɓuri semmbe.
Ɓaawo man, hakkee mongorooje man fuu weli masin, sey suuno nanngi yam, mi nyaamdi ɗe pat!”
                            
                                        Sey baaba Bello wi’i, “Too, jonta kam nyaamu nyiiri ma, a yaha a yiiwa, a tammi waɗugo daama.”

                                        Ɓernde Bello metti.  O waawataa nyaamugo nyiiri, no ndi uuriri fuu.
O waawataa boo yiiwugo.

                    Ngam naawugo reedu haɗi mo waɗugo koo ɗume.

                    Sey tan o jaɓɓiti saarooji maako, o nasti, o waali.
Bello wi’i, “Mi nyaami mongorooje sappo. Jonta reedu am ɗon naawa.”
Sey doktaajo wi’i, “Mongorooje sappo! Ko waɗi a nyaami mongorooje sappo?”

                                Sey sempti Bello, o jaabi, “Too, ɓeldum maaje sakli yam tan.”
                            
                                        Sey doktaajo wi’i, “Too.  Nden boo a looti ɗe hiddee ko a nyaama ɗe na?”
Bello wi’i, “Kai, mi lootaay.”

                    Sey doktaajo wi’i fahin, “Too.”

                    Bello hultori, o ƴami, “On tufatam baatal na? Ngam mi yiɗaa baate!”
Sey doktaajo jaabi, “A’a, a yamɗitan bee hoore ma.  Ammaa, teema a tuutan tawon, ko boo a riiwan.  Sey bana ni’i ɓanndu ma waɗan daama.”
Bello woyi, o wi’i,
                                        “Mi yiɗaa tuutugo!
                                        Mi yiɗaa riiwugo! Mi yiɗaa reedu am naawa!  Mi anndaa no mongorooje kalluɗe bana ni’i!”
                                    
                                Doktaajo wi'i, “A'a!  Mongorooje hallaay sam.  Ɗe ɗon hokka njamu ɓanndu.
“Ammaa foti gilkon nyiddukon takka laral maaje a anndaa, nden to kon nasti ɓanndu ma, kon nyawnete.
                                    
                                                Kanjum on
                                                ndikka a tokka
                                                lootugo ɗe
                                                hiddee ko a
                                                nyaama ɗe.
“Ɓurna fuu, sey a faama: koo kuuje boɗɗe wartan kalluɗe to a nyaami ɗuuɗɗe haa ɓuri semmbe!”
                            
                                        Bee maajum, doktaajo jaɓɓiti ɓe, ɓe hooti saare.
Reedu Bello tokki daamugo mo haa fajiri.  Haa weeti, fakat o tuuti, o riiwi.
                
                    Ammaa nde tuure bee riiwre timmi, sey nden o yamɗiti!

                    Saarooji maako seyi nde ɓe laari o yamɗiti.

title: Goso the Teacher
text:
Woodi goɗɗo feere, innde maako Goso.  O ɗonno ekkitina ɓikkoy janngugo ammaa naa haa suudu janngirde, haa les leggal tummude.
Nde ɓikkon wari tawi mallumjo maɓɓe maayi, ɗon waali haa leddi, ɓernde maɓɓe metti soosey.

                    Ɓe yiɗi ɓe ɗaɓɓita moy mbari Goso.
Sey ɓe nanngi Henndu Fombinaaru, ɓe wi’i ndu:

                    “An on yandini tummude nde mbarini amin mallumjo amin Goso!  A waɗi aybe!”
Sey Henndu Fombinaaru lorniti, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, ko waɗi mahol loope aatata mi?”
Sey Mahol Loope man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, doomburu logan nder am saala na?”
Sey Doomburu man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, faaturu nyaamatam no na?”
Sey Faaturu man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, mi haɓɓataake no bee ɓoggol, ko?”
Sey Ɓoggol man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, laɓi ta’atam no na?”
Sey Laɓi man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, yiite wulatam no na?”
Sey Yiite man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, ndiyam nyifatam no na?”
Sey Ndiyam man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana ni, nagge yaratam no na?”
Sey Nagge man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, mbuubu ngaatatam no na?”
Sey Mbuubu man wi’i, “To mi ɗonno mari semmbe bana nii, lelwa nyaamatam no na?
Hilni Lelwa dow ɓikkon man heftiri nga.  Ngam maajum nga walaa wolde.

                    Sey ɓikkon wi’i; “An on yandini tummude nde fiyi mallumjo amin haa hoore, o maayi!  An on haandi hiiteego!”

                    Nonnon boo kannga amti nga.
Lartu ko a faami!

                    1. Ɗume waɗi mallumjo Goso?
                    2. Moy ɓikkon man arti wulli?
                    3. Ɗume Faaturu, Laɓi, Ndiyam bee Nagge jaabiri ɓikkon?
                    4. Noy ɓikkon waɗi haa ɓe hefti mo mbari mallumjo maɓɓe Goso?

title: মিতু গুণতে পারে
text:
Nyannde feere daada Fatima neli mo luumo.

                                Nde Fatima don yaha o fuɗɗi limugo ko o laari.
Arande Fatima laari nagge mannge woote.

                                Fatima wi’i, “A ummi jam na, Nagge?”  Sey nagge wi’i, “Muu.”
Fatima laari ɓikkon ɗiɗo ɗon dogga.

                                        “Toy on yahata?” Fatima ƴami ɓe, ammaa ɓe nanaay mo.
Nden Fatima saali  paatuuhon taton haa sera laawol.

                                Fatima ƴami kon, “Toy daadiraawo mon?”
                                Kon sankiti tan.
Sey Fatima laari mongorooje nayi ɓenduɗe haa lisal leesungal.

                                        “Ndaa jonta mi ɗon nana weelo,” Fatima numi.
Ɓaawo maajum Fatima saali rewɓe njowo ɗon sotta gawri.

                                Fatima wi’i, “Rewɓe ɗo sembiɗɓe!”
Fatima jali nde o laari ɓinngel ɗon haɓda durugo ɓe’i joweego.

                                        “Fakat kuugal maagel hoyaay,” Fatima numi.
Nden Fatima laari colli joweeɗiɗi ɗon fija nder geene.

                                “Noy to min maa mi waawi fiirugo bana mon?” Fatima wi’i.
Sey Fatima saali ɓikkon joweetaton ɗon yeewta haa les ɗowɗi leggal.

                                        “Ɗume ɓe yeewtata?” Fatima ƴami hoore mum.
Ɓaawo man, Fatima fotti bee rewɓe feere ɓe ɗon wula butaali jey coggu. O limi butaali joweenayi.

                                “Ɗi ɗon uura,” Fatima wi’i.
Haa ragare Fatima laari gertokon sappo ɗon suppita nyaamdu haa leddi.  Fatima tokki kon bee limngal, “Go’o, ɗiɗi, tati, nayi, jowi, joweego, joweeɗiɗi, joweetati, joweenayi, sappo!”
Haa dow laawol yahugo luumo, Fatima limi kuuje feere-feere diga go’o yahugo sappo.  

                                An boo a limi bee maako!
